subject.title: Feature Request: Add parseMode config for Telegram channels

question: Which Telegram outbound modes should be supported beyond the existing `richMessages` choice, and what precedence should a channel default and account override have across final sends, captions, edits, and draft previews?
rationale: The remaining work adds public configuration and selects rendering and escaping semantics; source evidence does not establish that MarkdownV2, plain text, raw HTML, or per-account overrides are all desired long-term contracts.

options.title: Define a narrow supported selector
options.body: Support a small typed mode set with one documented precedence rule and retain the existing rich-message default for existing users.

options.title: Document the existing toggle only
options.body: Treat `richMessages` as the supported rich-versus-standard delivery choice and close the broader selector request without adding new modes.

options.title: Design a broader rendering API
options.body: Approve MarkdownV2 or raw-HTML-related capabilities only with an explicit escaping, trust-boundary, and migration contract.

recommendation.title: Define a narrow supported selector
recommendation.body: Support a small typed mode set with one documented precedence rule and retain the existing rich-message default for existing users.

likelyOwner.reason: The formatter transition and Telegram configuration history most directly connect this person to the mode and compatibility decision.
